items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: And H. Shaw was, uh, H. Shaw was singing baritone.

ctx.x: Uh, Bud was just about the best around here. And, uh, we had, uh, a boy used to sing with them. We had a quartet. I was singing tenor. Bud was leading. Walter King was, uh, singing baritone. And H. Shaw was, uh, H. Shaw was singing baritone. And, uh, his son was singing, uh, bass. We had a pretty good quartet. But, uh, singing, uh, we ain't had anyone around here that could be Bud singing.
I was wondering about some of the people that used to play with Walter Barnes back around 1928 or 29. Do you remember Cicero Thomas? He's a trumpet player?
